checks.description: Controlled/uncontrolled both directions, default seeded once, false distinct from absent; native dismissal latches true request closed until false/true or trigger rearm; open-at-press-start closes without reopening.
User trigger/dismiss callbacks fire once with reason, caller changes never notify and disabled trigger cannot open but permits native closing cleanup.
Live native trigger anchors four logical sides and three alignments plus token gap; native flip/RTL/work-area clamp operates on both axes with no arrow.
Trigger moves/resizes update native placement and detach closes without stale native anchor use.
No entry request precedes readiness; confirmed first-content result avoids fallback surface stop.

checks.description: Every pointer/keyboard/accessibility/caller open enters first eligible content after readiness, or makes/focuses surface if none; stale/refused/cancelled outcomes are not confirmed or retried by timer.

Escape/outside/deactivation/anchor loss close; Escape and caller close of focused popup return live eligible trigger with native confirmation, outside preserves pointer destination, deactivate/detach never move focus.
Native Tab/Shift+Tab wrap inside popup, content owns navigation and Escape remains keyboard exit; presentation never focused does not move focus when closed.
